[quote=western_view;60043980][spoiler=A Blood Debt Repaid][b][u]12:35 pm, Friday, August 1, Wessernian Road[/u][/b]
Tony Messiaon is leaving the hospital after many days of recovering from a broken arm, a shattered leg, a concussion, blood loss, and 2 degree burns to his head and chest. He has been told to try not to engage in anything that could prevent his injuries form healing, thus he should stay inside and try to move as little as possible. Crowds have lined up on the beautiful side walks, and wave banners of appreciation do to the fact that this is his first public appearance, before he had made virtual speeches, but now he's out in his open roofed car. It's a beautiful day with clear skies, and perfect visibility. Then there's a loud [b]BANG![/b] And suddenly Tony Messiaon falls to his knees, then he collapses, blood sprays onto the road, no one can believe what they just saw, Tony Messiaon, beloved head council member, and less a rich politician, and more everyones friendly neighbor that will come over and give you food when you're sick, the Tony Messiaon, was assassinated. People starred in shock as the car turned around, closed its roof and flew down the street, right towards the hospital it had just came from. Then the realization hit them, the shooter could still be around, looking for their target. People started running, parents covered their kids, no one knew if their would be more shots or not. But many people were thinking, what would happen to our glorious nation, and what would happen to Tony Messiaon.

[b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Today is a day of mourning, as our beloved Tony Messiaon has been killed, shot by a ruthless man who most likely supports Guhui'Bernardio, and Hatzur Zatsugiu, after all the are a known 13,249 people in Guhi'Bernardio, including Hatzur himself. Many of those in Guhui'Bernardio are very capable men, who excel in computer science, guns, bombs or other useful things for a terrorist group to have, in fact it's suspected that their are men in Guhui'bernardio who are in the military but we can not confirm or deny the the rumors. The shooter has been confirmed and caught, the man is named Kiliwo Danf and was once in WVSOU (Western View Special Operations Unit) thus he was a very useful asset to Hatzur Zatsugi, though he may not have been as useful as before, since Hatzur had sent him on a practical suicide mission. Kilwo Danf has been sentenced to the death sentence, specifically by being shot. Though the damage has been done. We have word that a new head council will be elected, most likely Tony Messiaon's brother Mack Mesiaon.[/spoiler]

[quote=lamandica;60042811][b][i] MESSAGE FROM KIEBS: [/i][/b]

The following message is transmitted by the Lamandican Department of Internal Security and the Taultion Constabulary. A CIVIL DANGER message has been issued for the City of Taultion until further notice. Daniel Foster Tower has collapsed. Only emergency management is allowed within half a kilometer of tower. CIVIL DANGER alert has been cancelled for City of Taultion, the following municipalities in Titus province, Gischarleschett, Berktin-Sertle, and Dunningsborough, and the following municipalities in Victoria province, Freetown. At 13:01 LST, the suspected terrorists have been found after reports of a tractor trailer matching the description of the one the individuals used to flee the scene of the bombing veered off Lamandican Highway 1, crashed into a ravine near Cencongrensce, or 31 miles north of Tewsomah. The tractor trailer reportedly exploded with both occupants inside. Lamandican Highway 1 between Junctions 252 and 259 had been closed off. More updates will be provided on local news sources and future updates on both situations. This concludes this emergency bulletin.[/quote]

Night falls on a mourning nation. The tragic collapse of the Daniel Foster Tower has so far left 494 civilians dead, 1,686 injured, and 1,002 still missing. Crews keep working to find survivors into the night. The collapse of the tower damaged other nearby buildings mainly north of it. Some of the debris from the collapse caused a nearby 18th century building to collapse and destroy a statue of General Daniel Foster next to it.

As for the terrorists, they were found dead at the sight of the tractor trailer crash on L.H. 1. The tractor trailer was registered to a construction and maintenance company located in Guadetero province. Surveillance video from last night showed that around 01:07 LST last night, the two terrorists, which have been identified as Hovekamp Pheved and Omar Jahaussing, found an unlocked tractor trailer in the yard of the building with the keys in the ignition, and drove it out of the yard. They may have went to an undisclosed location after to get the bombs and dynamite used to bomb the Daniel Foster Tower.

The reason why they were traveling to Wichenvidence after bombing the tower was to do the same to the WonderTower, which due to the Daniel Foster Towers collapse, is now Lamandicas tallest building. However, due to the rugged twists and turning of the road, as well as the wet road conditions from thunderstorms the night before, caused the tractor trailer to hydroplane and veer off the road into a ravine. When the tractor trailer crashed, a small fire started in the container of the truck, where the bombs were stored, causing all the bombs to detonate before Pheved and Jahaussing could get out, killing them on the spot.

Not much was known about Pheved and Jahaussin before, with some citizens fearing, due to recent events in Western View, that there might be an uprising in Lamandica, others fearing they were outraged at the government, and others suspecting that they might be part of an international terrorist organization. The Lamandican Investigation Bureau and Department of Internal Security are currently investigating further into this incident, as not much is known at this time.
